officer.title: Extension officer dashboard

officer.noData: No data for this sub-county yet.
officer.suppressed: Some totals are hidden to protect privacy because fewer than 10 farmers are included.
officer.assistedIntro: Register on the farmer’s behalf and record their consent.
officer.farmerNameHint: Use the name the farmer agrees to share. Initials are fine.

officer.notePlaceholder: Optional short note. Do not include personal details.

officer.loadError: We could not load the dashboard.
officer.locationHint: Use the farmer’s description of the plot location. GPS is not required.
officer.invalidFarmer: Check the farmer name, phone number and plot details.
officer.farmersEmpty: No farmers registered in this sub-county yet.
officer.assistedConsentBody: I explained the purpose, the channels and the data sharing rules to the farmer. The farmer agreed.
